sentences.text:
And Anoth Counsel for Applicant :- Ashutosh Pratap Singh,Kunwar Bahadur Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and pursued the record.

The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. No. 020 of 2021, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B, 409 I.P.C. and Section 3/7 E.C.
Act, Police Station Khodare, District Gonda.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicants have falsely been implicated in the present case.
He further submitted that applicants were the members of the committee headed by the Village Pradhan as the main allegation was against fair price shop dealer, namely, Shah Ali.

He further submitted that FIR of the case in question was challenged before this Court in Writ Petition No.9409 of 2021, in which, arrest of the applicants along with others was stayed by this Court on 26.03.2021 till filing of the police report, but in the most mechanical manner, investigation was Samiulla And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy./ Addl. ...

He further submitted that co-accused, namely, Shah Ali (fair price shop dealer) as well as Ram Sanehi (Gram Pradhan) have already been granted anticipatory bail by this Court.
He further submitted that applicants never misuse the liberty granted by the Investigating Officer.

He also relied on the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Sushila Aggarwal And Other Vs. State (NCT of Delhi) And Another reported in (2020) 5 SCC 1 and Siddarth vs. State of U.P. & Anr. reported in 2021 SCC OnLine SC 615.

sentences.text:
In such circumstances,
applicants are entitled for protection of this Court under the provisions of anticipatory bail.

Learned A.G.A. opposes the prayer of the applicants, but he does not dispute the fact that co-accused, namely, Shah Ali (fair price shop dealer) as well as Ram Sanehi (Gram Pradhan) have already been granted anticipatory bail by this Court.

Considering the argument of the learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. and going through the contents of the F.I.R., bail application, order passed by the writ Court and other relevant records, the present anticipatory bail application stands finally disposed of with the direction that till the submission of the police report, if any, under Section 173(2) Cr.P.C. before the competent court, in the event of arrest of the applicants- namely, Samiulla and Sunita, involved in aforesaid F.I.R., they shall be released on anticipatory bail on their furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer of the police station concerned with the following conditions:-
(1) The applicants shall make himself available for interrogation or for discovery of any fact by a police officer/investigating officer as and when required and will cooperate in the investigation.

(2) The applicants shall not, directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer;
(3) The applicants shall not leave the country without the previous permission of the Court.
(4) The applicants shall deposit his passport with the trial court and if he has not been issued any passport, an affidavit in this regard shall be filed by him before the trial court.
Any violation of above conditions will be treated misuse of bail and court below will be at liberty to pass appropriate order in the matter.

Order Date :- 21.4.2023 Amit/-
